name: URTC-DEVTOOLS
notes: The shared repository tools of the URTC family as a versioned set: the canonical copy of the documentation-policy and README-parity checks, the picture generators, the live panel of the build scripts, the manifest version bumper, the status-light check and the dashboard notice (files/), with the version of the repository as the version of the set. A repository takes the set with the synchroniser of URTC-DOCS, which writes a lock file with the version and the SHA-256 of every file; the check compares the lock with the files, so a hand edit and a copy that fell behind are both found. Every repository stays buildable with its own checkout. Scaffolding on purpose: the repositories of the family have not yet moved to the lock.
